Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
Urinalysis shows significant leukocyturia, bacteriuria, nitrites, and positive urine culture for >100,000 CFU/mL E. coli, consistent with a urinary tract infection. Presence of hematuria and mild proteinuria may be secondary to infection. Low specific gravity may indicate dilute urine. Glucosuria is noted and may warrant further evaluation for hyperglycemia/diabetes. No ketones or casts detected. Recommend clinical correlation and appropriate antimicrobial therapy.
